name: com.leochaumartin.quill
description: A declarative, reactive UI framework for Unity. Author interfaces in .quill documents with reactive bindings, anchors, positioners, reusable components, signals, animations and custom shaders, and restyle them with themes: every theme implements the same controls, so switching theme never means editing a document. Rendered at a low level (single SDF pass for rectangles, lightweight textured layers for text/images/effects), independent of uGUI and UI Toolkit. URP and Built-in render pipelines supported.

samples.description: The built-in theme's gallery scene: clean and flat, for settings screens, tools and simulations. Slate itself ships with the package; this sample is just the scene.
Frosted glass panes that blur and refract your 3D scene, for premium menus and HUDs. Controls, palette, the Inter font and a gallery scene with an animated backdrop.
Neon on midnight with glowing outlines, for racing, rhythm and retro-wave games. Controls, palette, the Orbitron and Rajdhani fonts and a gallery scene.
Ink on parchment with a wax-red accent, for RPG inventories, quest logs and dialogue. Controls, palette, the Cinzel and EB Garamond fonts and a gallery scene.
Hairlines, corner brackets and monospace capitals, for sci-fi HUDs, strategy and simulation. Controls, palette, the Share Tech Mono font and a gallery scene.
Soft clay, pastels and springy motion, for casual and mobile games. Controls, palette, the Fredoka and Nunito fonts and a gallery scene.
Chunky bevelled pixels and a 16-colour palette, for 2D retro games. Controls, palette, the Press Start 2P and Pixelify Sans fonts and a gallery scene.
Thick ink, hard shadows and loud colours, for party, puzzle and comic-style games. Controls, palette, the Bangers and Nunito fonts and a gallery scene.
